regain.title: Calling: {calling} daily regain
regain.body: Critical success on {action}. This is the first time today, so {name} can regain 1 Mythic Point.
regain.bodyTarget: Critical success on {action} against {target}. This is the first time today, so {name} can regain 1 Mythic Point.
regain.already: {name} already regained a Mythic Point from their Calling today.
regain.failed: Mythic Powers: the Calling regain failed. See the console for details.

gm.enemy: GM: the check had no target. Restore only if it was against an enemy.
gm.notAlly: GM: the check had no target. Restore only if the creature isn't an ally.
gm.dreams: GM: restore only if the subject was dreaming or the Dreamlands.
gm.library: GM: restore only if the character was researching in a library or similar facility.
gm.tradition: GM: restore only if the skill matches one of the character's magical traditions.
gm.wildAnimal: GM: restore only if the target was a wild animal.
gm.notCompanion: GM: restore only if the animal isn't the character's pet or companion.
gm.words: GM: restore only if the diversion used the character's words.
gm.audience: GM: restore only if the audience was indifferent or unfriendly.

death.title: ✦ Death Denied
death.body: {name} reached {dying}, but mythic power holds them here. They stabilize at 0 HP.
death.failed: Mythic Powers: the mythic death rule failed. See the console for details.
